before:
# 🧭️ Own workspace root: linked by `../📜️script.ts` (`cargo run --manifest-path`), never joins the
# repository's root workspace, whose root manifest is a shared, contended file.
#
# Builds this subset's `third-party-generated` fixtures with the SAME registered reference crate
# (`las` 0.11) named in `../../🔣️oracle.json`'s `las-1-0-any-mutate` oracle — never with this
# repository's own `encode_las`. See `../📜️script.ts` for the generation contract.
[workspace]
members = ["../../../../🧫️fixtures/📦️packages/🦀️rust"]

[workspace.metadata.semio.repository]
exclude-patterns = []
schema-version = 1
member-manifests = ["Cargo.toml"]

[package]
name = "las-1-0-any-fixture-generator"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "generate"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
las = "0.11"
